name: Foundation Layer
description: Base data types, serialization, and file I/O. No dependencies on other application layers.

name: Core Engine
description: VM objects, elements, wires, simulation logic, and configuration. Depends on Foundation.

name: Parser Layer
description: Expression and Verilog parsing. Consumes core types, used by editor and code generation.

name: Editor State Machine
description: BasisStatus states controlling editor interaction modes (idle, edit, resize, add element, add wire, run). Depends on Core Engine.

name: Reusable UI Components
description: Specialized Swing widgets: code editor, graph renderer, property editor, color picker.

name: Networking / Simulator Communication
description: Socket-based client/server for remote simulator communication.

name: UI Composition Layer
description: Top-level frames, panels, dialogs, and project management. Composes components from all lower layers.

name: Utility / Support Tools
description: Auxiliary tools: logic gates, binary displays, flow management, ZIP utilities, software updater.
